name: @loom/mcp-app-release-approval
description: Serves a Loom agent surface as an MCP App (SEP-1865) via @loom/plugin-mcp-app: one static content-pinned surface-host template, an ambient app-visibility cursor that substitutes for the extension's missing server push, and decision provenance (seenSequence/isStale) across a long-held approval gate. The View is the REAL template, executed in jsdom against a real MCP server over HTTP.
